baseline_models.focus_anchor: The restricted clause 'his wealth and offspring did not increase him except in loss.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Wealth and offspring form a compound asset base, but the negated increase and exception convert every increment from that base into loss; the trade-loss branch makes the result an adverse return rather than mere non-help.

activation_trace.role: The increase-and-growth image supplies the expected upward motion that the restriction reverses.
The acquiring-and-having-wealth image supplies the accumulated capital whose return is being assessed.
The born-offspring image supplies familial continuation as the second apparent asset.
The trade-loss image turns the final deficiency into a negative yield on the preceding assets.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and children simply failed to benefit the followed person.
changed_reading.after: His apparent assets behave like a compounding portfolio whose only booked return is loss.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from 'they disobeyed me' to 'they followed whoever' and then to that person's loss-producing assets.
baseline_models.mechanism: Following is more than proximity: the attached-liability branch lets allegiance transmit a patron's consequence to followers, while wealth and offspring give that patron a durable social extension.

activation_trace.role: The following-after image supplies directed compliance with the person placed ahead.
The incurred-liability image makes consequence attach to the act of following.
The wealth-possession image supplies material leverage for the followed patron.
The offspring image supplies kin continuity that extends the patron's reach.
The general-deficiency image names the consequence inherited along the allegiance chain.

changed_reading.before: The people copied a wealthy person who happened to be unsuccessful.
changed_reading.after: They attached themselves to a patronage chain whose prestige recruits followers and whose liability travels with the attachment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Noah's address 'my Lord' followed by disobedience to him and following another person.
baseline_models.mechanism: Noah addresses the nurturing sovereign while reporting movement out of obedience and into the orbit of a resource-rich human center; the sequence reads as a transfer of formative authority.

activation_trace.role: The repair-nurture-completion image frames lordship as formation sustained stage by stage.
The leaving-obedience image supplies the break from one formative relation.
The following-after image supplies entry into the replacement relation.
The wealth image gives the rival center material capacity to organize dependence.
The offspring image gives the rival center continuity through kin.

changed_reading.before: Noah reports two separate faults: disobedience and bad imitation.
changed_reading.after: The two verbs trace one social transfer, away from divine-messenger formation and toward dynastic material authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The opening speech frame 'Noah said: my Lord.'
baseline_models.mechanism: Uttered speech addressed to the Lord functions as an indication: the verse presents the following clause as a causal diagnosis submitted for judgment, not as detached narration.

activation_trace.role: The uttered-speech image marks an overt report rather than an unspoken impression.
The thing-as-indication image lets the saying function as evidence of an underlying social mechanism.
The lordship-and-authority image identifies the addressee before whom the diagnosis is lodged.

changed_reading.before: 'Noah said' is only a narrative transition.
changed_reading.after: The speech frame casts the verse as Noah's compact evidentiary account of how allegiance produces loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commissioning in 71:1 and the ordered worship-obedience sequence in 71:3 make 'they disobeyed me' a break in a transmitted command chain; the personal object marks the messenger interface, not a merely personal grievance.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message image supplies Noah's commissioned relay position in the command chain.
The worship-as-submissive-obedience image supplies the chain's divine orientation.
The yielding-obedience image makes obedience to Noah the explicit human link of that orientation.
The leaving-obedience image marks rupture at the messenger link.
The lordship image keeps Noah's report anchored in the authority from which the mission came.

structural_cues: 71:1 commissions Noah, and 71:3 places obedience to him after worship and protective fear of God.
The first-person object in 71:21 therefore closes a previously stated relay relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commission, worship, obedience, and later disobedience; I infer a delegated-authority chain from their sequence. A live alternative is that obedience to Noah remains an independent communal duty rather than a relay image.

changed_reading.before: The people affront Noah's personal leadership.
changed_reading.after: Their disobedience severs the commissioned route by which the divine summons reaches them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night/day and public/private alternation make Noah's address temporally and socially comprehensive; his speech in 71:21 is therefore a compressed audit after varied channels have been exhausted.

activation_trace.role: The calling-and-inclining-by-speech image supplies the repeated outreach operation.
The night-and-darkness image supplies one half of the outreach's temporal coverage.
The daylight-opening image supplies the complementary visible half of that coverage.
The public-declaration and raised-voice image supplies the overt social channel.
The hidden-interior image supplies the private channel complementary to public declaration.
The uttered-speech image turns the accumulated outreach record into a spoken report.
The leaving-obedience image names the stable result after all channels were tried.

structural_cues: 71:5-9 repeats Noah's first-person calling while alternating night/day and public/private modes.
71:21 resumes the same 'said, my Lord' report frame after that outreach sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the temporal and communicative alternations; I infer that their pairing represents practical exhaustiveness and makes 71:21 an audit conclusion. The alternative is simple rhetorical intensification without a claim of exhausted channels.

changed_reading.before: Noah's complaint could be a reaction to an isolated refusal.
changed_reading.after: The verse records a stable social diagnosis reached after outreach across times, settings, and degrees of publicity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact increase-negation-exception pattern in 71:6 and 71:21 creates reciprocal trajectories: Noah's call increases their flight, while the assets of the one they follow increase his loss. Refusal and patronage are not static states but self-amplifying systems.

activation_trace.role: The increase-and-growth image supplies the shared directional operator in the first exception construction.
The calling-by-speech image supplies the input that, paradoxically, intensifies movement away.
The flight-and-escape image supplies the first construction's sole increasing output.
The same increase image binds the focus clause to the earlier amplification pattern.
The wealth image supplies one input to the second amplification system.
The offspring image supplies the second, socially reproductive input.
The deficiency image supplies the second construction's sole increasing output.

structural_cues: 71:6 and 71:21 repeat the full frame 'did not increase ... except ...' with different inputs and outputs.
Flight in the first frame leads into following in the focus verse, linking escape from one call to attachment elsewhere.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two nearly identical increase-only-exception constructions; I infer that the echo invites a reciprocal causal ledger in which each orientation amplifies its own result. The live alternative is formal emphasis without a system-level causal parallel.

changed_reading.before: The focus clause says only that assets fail and become loss.
changed_reading.after: It is the second half of a paired feedback pattern: the rejected call compounds flight, and the chosen patronage compounds loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 71:12, wealth and sons are connected extensions offered after seeking forgiveness; in 71:21, closely matching assets yield only loss under a contrary allegiance. The assets are therefore not intrinsically condemned: orientation controls their polarity.

activation_trace.role: The connected-increase supplying aid or material image frames the promised assets as sustaining extension.
The having-wealth image provides the same material category that reappears in the focus loss clause.
The filiation-and-origin image supplies sons as lineage extension parallel to focus offspring.
The wealth image marks the repeated asset now operating with reversed value.
The offspring image marks the repeated kin asset now operating with reversed value.
The trade-loss image supplies the negative valuation produced under the changed orientation.

structural_cues: 71:10-12 sequences seeking forgiveness before rain, wealth, sons, gardens, and rivers.
71:21 repeats wealth and kin after the people's choice to follow a rival center.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the same asset classes in a promised extension and in an exclusive loss; I infer that allegiance and response determine their sign. An alternative is that the two passages contrast recipients without making a general claim about asset polarity.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and offspring are themselves corrupting possessions.
changed_reading.after: They are amplifiers whose value reverses with orientation: connected aid in one relation, compounding loss in another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prestigious command not to abandon the deities supplies the message carried by the rival patronage network. Circulating doctrine, elevated headship, and deviation explain how material and dynastic standing can convert one leader's loss into many followers' route.

activation_trace.role: The circulating-public-talk image supplies the medium by which elite instruction spreads beyond its speakers.
The held-doctrine image makes the utterance a transmissible allegiance rather than a momentary remark.
The elevated-honor-and-headship image supplies status capable of authorizing the counter-message.
The deviation-from-guidance image supplies the many-person outcome of the circulated doctrine.
The following-after image supplies the uptake relation between patrons and audience.
The wealth image supplies material prestige for the counter-message's patrons.
The offspring image supplies a kin network that can preserve and relay patronal doctrine.

structural_cues: 71:22-24 moves from a great scheme to an imperative speech preserving named deities and then to many being led astray.
The singular or generic 'whoever' in 71:21 can remain open while the later plural speakers expose a leadership network.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prestigious plotting, a public doctrinal command, and many deviating; I infer that wealth and offspring are the infrastructure of that counter-message. The alternative is that 'whoever' names a generic wealthy class without a coordinated leadership mechanism.

changed_reading.before: People follow wealth because they admire prosperity.
changed_reading.after: Material and dynastic prestige fund an authoritative counter-message that recruits and reproduces followers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opened earth provides traversable wide routes, while later deviation marks a failed direction; against that spatial field, following becomes stepwise route adoption. Patronal allegiance selects a path whose accumulated consequence is loss.

activation_trace.role: The penetrating-a-road image supplies active entry into a chosen course.
The extended-traversable-path image supplies the available route structure.
The wide-open-pass image makes the routes capacious enough for collective movement.
The deviation-from-guidance image assigns directional failure to the collective route.
The stepwise-tracking image converts social following into repeated movement along another's trace.
The attached-liability image makes the path's consequence adhere to those who enter it.
The deficiency image supplies the destination produced by the tracked route.

structural_cues: 71:19-20 moves from a spread earth to the purpose of traversing wide paths.
71:24 later names collective deviation, allowing the physical route field to activate social direction in 71:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies traversable routes, deviation, and focus branches for stepwise tracking; I infer that social allegiance behaves as path-dependent movement. The alternative is that the route verses remain cosmological evidence with no social carryover.

changed_reading.before: Following is a single act of imitation.
changed_reading.after: Following is repeated entry into an established social route, with each step inheriting the route's accumulating loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prediction that they generate only a transgressive ingrate exposes offspring as a transmission channel for orientation, while the faithful household in 71:28 prevents biological determinism. The loss-producing child asset is the reproduction of a social pattern, not the bare existence of children.

activation_trace.role: The generated-or-derived-thing image supplies offspring as an output carrying qualities from its source system.
The deviation-and-tearing-a-cover image supplies one quality reproduced by that system.
The covering-a-blessing image supplies the other reproduced quality and links generation to squandered benefit.
The household-and-dependents image supplies a social kin unit broader than biological descent alone.
The heart-settling-trust image supplies faith as the criterion that reorganizes household belonging.
The born-offspring image anchors the activated transmission model in the focus asset.
The deficiency image names the negative yield of reproduced orientation.

structural_cues: 71:27 uses an exclusive-result construction for what the resistant group will beget.
71:28 immediately names parents, Noah's household entrant, and believing men and women, distinguishing descent from faithful belonging.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies predicted birth outcomes and then a faith-defined household; I infer that focus offspring carries a reproduced social orientation rather than a fixed biological essence. The alternative is a narrower prediction about descendants with no institutional transmission model.

changed_reading.before: Children count as prestige that fails to protect their parent.
changed_reading.after: Offspring are a generative channel: under this patronage they reproduce the very orientation whose yield is loss, while faithful household membership remains possible by allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence of drowning, entry into fire, failed finding, and absent helpers realizes the focus loss as total protection failure. Wealth and offspring had made the followed patron look sheltering, but neither material nor social capital can interrupt the terminal sequence.

activation_trace.role: The drowning-in-water image supplies the first comprehensive failure of worldly security.
The entering-an-interior image supplies an irreversible transition into the next consequence.
The finding-and-reaching image, under negation, supplies the failed search for an exit resource.
The aid-and-manifest-support image supplies precisely what the patronage network cannot provide.
The wealth image anchors the failed material-protection side of the model.
The offspring image anchors the failed social-protection side of the model.
The deficiency image is expanded by the later sequence into unrecoverable protection loss.

structural_cues: 71:25 gives a rapid passive sequence from drowning to entry into fire and then explicitly denies helpers.
The focus names material and kin assets immediately before that realization of helplessness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies terminal enclosure and no aid; I infer that wealth and offspring were followed partly as protective capital and that 71:25 audits their failure. The alternative is that the denied helpers are only the deities of 71:23, not the focus patron's assets.

changed_reading.before: Loss is an abstract moral deficit accruing to the wealthy leader.
changed_reading.after: Loss becomes the collapse of every expected protection: assets, kin, and allied help cannot arrest the consequence sequence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping from focus ز ي د to the journey-provision root, not the ordinary sense of يزيد. It remains anchored by that supplied focus mapping and by context branches for entering roads and going out. Downstream prose should present it only as exploratory root-play, never as a lexical replacement for 'increase.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus token at word 9, followed immediately by wealth, offspring, and loss.

activation_trace.role: The carrying-provision-for-a-journey image recasts the apparent increases as stores meant to survive transition.
The entering-a-road image supplies the transition for which provision would normally be useful.
The extended-path image supplies the journey field across which the stores are carried.
The passing-outside image supplies the ultimate transition that tests what can actually be carried.
The deficiency image turns stored provision into a load that fails its journey purpose.

changed_reading.before: Wealth and offspring are quantities that increase but yield loss.
changed_reading.after: As exploratory word-play, they are provisions packed for passage that become losing baggage when the decisive transition arrives.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-dominant split mapping of focus ر ب ب to the usurious-surplus branch and places it beside increase, wealth, and trade loss. It remains focus-anchored through the packet's exact mapping and produces a coherent financial counter-image. Downstream prose must label it branch-induced word-play, not a gloss of رب or a legal claim about the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence 'my Lord ... did not increase him, his wealth ... except in loss.'

activation_trace.role: The usurious-surplus image supplies a false growth regime set in tension with the invoked Lord.
The increase-and-growth image supplies the apparent law of that rival regime.
The wealth-possession image supplies the capital on which surplus claims authority.
The trade-loss image exposes the rival growth regime's actual balance.

changed_reading.before: Noah invokes the Lord and then reports a wealthy person's failed increase.
changed_reading.after: As contained word-play, true lordship is opposed by a pseudo-lordship of surplus whose promised increase closes as trade loss.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the packet's non-dominant fewness mapping under focus ق و ل and contrasts it with the explicit many of 71:24. It remains anchored to the opening focus token and a branch-backed context quantity, but it is phonetic-mapping resonance rather than syntax. Downstream prose should qualify it as a minorized-voice image, not translate قال as 'few.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The initial 'Noah said' set against the later statement that many were led astray.

activation_trace.role: The fewness-and-smallness image supplies the experimental sense of a numerically minor voice.
The abundance-and-growing-number image supplies the many-person field against which that voice is heard.
The uttered-speech image keeps the outlier attached to Noah's actual speaking act.
The following-after image explains how numerical weight gathers on the opposing side.

changed_reading.before: The speech frame has no relation to the group's numerical scale.
changed_reading.after: As a contained resonance, Noah's utterance is a minorized voice diagnosing a prestige system that has drawn the many into its wake.

strongest_changes: The repeated 'did not increase ... except ...' construction joins 71:6 and 71:21 into two self-amplifying trajectories: call to flight and patronage to loss.
Wealth and sons reverse polarity between the connected promise of 71:12 and the loss clause of 71:21, making allegiance rather than possession the controlling variable.
The later birth and household sequence changes offspring from a static status asset into a channel that can reproduce either resistant patronage or faith-defined belonging.
The later no-helper sequence realizes loss as collapse of material, kin, and allied protection rather than an abstract deficit alone.
summary.what_was_special: The focus verse is a compact causal hinge: it converts exhaustive rejected outreach into rival following, mirrors an earlier increase formula, and lets the same wealth-and-kin categories switch from promised extension to compounding loss. Path, liability, and generation branches expose how that reversal propagates socially, while split-root activations remain explicitly contained as word-play.
remaining_uncertainties: The singular or generic 'whoever' may indicate one patron, a type of wealthy leader, or a coordinated elite network.
The conditional polarity of wealth and offspring is an inference from juxtaposed sequences; the packet does not state the causal rule directly.
Path, liability, provision, surplus, and fewness models vary in branch distance and should not displace the verse's ordinary syntax or morphology.
